required_repairs_before_preregistration: Limit corpus to provably public, non-sensitive sources; document provenance and anonymization steps for every item.
Define taxonomy axes as precise, machine-readable descriptors and provide mapping rules with concrete examples tying attributes to verifier implementations.
Design and document an adversary-aware injection protocol balancing naturalistic and engineered failure modes; publish injection scripts and fixed seeds.
Provide containerized exemplar oracle implementations (Docker), unit tests, and a small end-to-end replication script; include a reproducibility checklist and packaging instructions.
